reviewer: Codex, unblinded source review of development cases
rubric: Usable central reading; minor edit for limited wording, attribution or role correction; material error for misleading actor, measurement, temporal scope or event. Mechanical status is separate.

records.note: Both retain the two discussions and their subjects. Candidate repeats the praise across publishers but introduces no material event.
Both combine absence reporting with the separate jersey story. Candidate avoids the unsupported full Sacramento Kings expansion, but previously adds chronology from the report sequence.
Control adds visible delight and an overall view of leadership/momentum. Candidate confines the reading to reported delight and hope about attitude and mentality.
Both preserve criticism and expressed disappointment. Candidate leaks instruction wording about not inventing consensus into the body.
Control assigns 89 games and the composite to the team cohort. Candidate correctly describes the Boston profile and supplied per-measure standings and changes.
Both keep the correct measurements or standings and the five-appearance sample limit. Candidate adds the supplied cohort size; no new measured quantity is invented.

Control incorrectly treats missing dated comparisons as preventing a current-balance reading. Candidate gives that contrast but changes conditional willingness to get paid elsewhere into desire to leave and introduces an unsupported 90th-percentile literal.
Control reverses the strong rebounding and turnover profile. Candidate instead calls the 54.2 composite poor and invents strategic disjointedness. Neither synthesis is faithful.

Both use the supplied performance/contract tension. Candidate has a supplied rising direction tag, but strengthens it into rising on-field metrics without a dated raw-measure comparison. Neither is independently verified against original reporting in this peer-card trial.
Control appends unrelated coach metadata. Candidate removes that name but converts injury-related absences into departures. Its parser acceptance is not a quality improvement.
Both preserve the Eagles signing. Candidate repeats the publisher's draft-bust characterization as its own description; it does not invent a Giants-to-Eagles move.
Both incorrectly call the two comparison windows the same. Candidate also exposes internal measure names in prose. This case is synthetic, not a real current snapshot.
